_meta.scope: Thinking Machines Lab Inkling 2 Small (2026-11-05, weights 2026-11-12) and Inkling 2 Mini (2026-11-20), added to chapter 3 as a new open-weight vendor.
_meta.notes: Vendor numbers from the launch posts, official model cards and the Hugging Face README. Independent numbers from the Artificial Analysis model pages (RSC data, v5.0.1) and Vals leaderboards (Vals Index v2.2, Terminal-Bench 4.0, both updated 2026-11-19). Prices from the Tinker models.json (prefill = input, sample = output) cross-checked with AA, OpenRouter, Together and Cloudflare. Not found anywhere: HLE full set with tools, CyberGym, OSWorld 2.1, Agents' Last Exam v1.1, ProgramBench 'almost solved' (Vals lists only 0.50% resolved for both).

caveats: AA labels GDPval-AA as v2.1 (legacy, not in Index v5.0.1); its values equal the 'v2' scores already in this column (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 1745.8 on both), so Inkling's 1630 / 1319 go in the same column with that note.
FrontierCode v2.0 in Thinking Machines' table (stirrup v0.2.1) is AA's FrontierCode-AA 2.0: AA's page gives 25.35 / 15.10 and the comparison values match AA (DeepSeek 28.5, GLM-5.3-Flash 17.6).
Mini active parameters: HF says 3.4B active, 5.4B effective active per token over three looped passes; Tinker, AA and the vendor table use 5.4B. The table shows 3.4B and explains 5.4B in the tip.
AA lists one setting per model with no effort suffix; Thinking Machines ran its own Small evals at effort 0.99 (xhigh), temperature 1.0.

Tinker's Inkling 2 prices sit in the Training table; the Serverless Inference (Beta) table lists only Inkling and Inkling-Small. AA and OpenRouter treat $0.30/$1.00 and $0.15/$0.50 as the first-party API price.
Chartography: the table takes the no-tools ('original') score; with-Python scores (82.1 / 72.5) are not used, consistent with chapter 3's rule.

tip.zh: Thinking Machines 自家 Tinker 价：输入 $0.30、输出 $1.00，缓存命中 $0.03（AA、OpenRouter 都按这个记第一方价）。Together、Nebius、Cloudflare 同价，DeepInfra $0.285 / $0.95。〔高〕
tip.en: Thinking Machines' own Tinker price: $0.30 input, $1.00 output, cached input $0.03 (AA and OpenRouter list this as the first-party price). Together, Nebius and Cloudflare charge the same; DeepInfra $0.285 / $0.95. [high]
